title: Row-scoped data quality warnings and database health view
points: Published the pipeline QC ledger into the serving database so open blockers and warnings can be matched to the exact ticker, period, table, statement section, and metric a query retrieves.
Answers now surface a data quality notice when retrieved rows overlap an open QC flag, with a short explanation of the deterministic checks behind the warning.
Added an admin database health matrix that shows tickers as rows and reporting periods as columns, with green, yellow, and red cells that expand into the underlying QC concerns.
